Needs to be refined in a blast furnace. | id = FlametalOreNew | type = Ore | source = [[Flametal ore vein]] in the [[Ashlands]] biome | usage = Smelting via [[Blast furnace]] | buy = | sell = | weight = 10.0 | stack = 30 | teleport = No }} '''Flametal ore''' is a metal ore obtained in [[Ashlands]]. It can be smelted into [[Flametal]] in a [[Blast furnace]] using [[Coal]] as fuel. Flametal ore can be obtained by: * Mining [[Flametal ore vein]]s in the [[Ashlands]], it requires at least a [[Black metal pickaxe]]. * Found at [[Charred Fortress|Charred Fortresses]] inside the [[Loot chest|Charred Chests]]. * By destroying [[Dvergr crate]] situated in [[Dvergr Charred tower ruins]]. * When fishing a [[Magmafish]]. == Gallery == Ancient ore.png|The icon of the unfinished Flametal ore (as ''Ancient ore'') == Notes == * Flametal was obtainable before the Ashlands update from [[Glowing metal]] piles and smelted into Flametal in a Blast furnace. * Flametal ore obtained before the Ashlands update converts to "Ancient ore" and remains unusable. It possesses the ID of FlametalOre, whereas newly obtained ores have an ID of FlametalOreNew. * Like other metals, Flametal ore cannot be teleported through a regular portal. It can be teleported through the [[Portal stone|Portal - Stone]] introduced in the Ashlands update. {{MaterialsNav}} [[cs:Plamenná kovová ruda]] [[ru:Огнеметаллическая руда]] [[uk:Руда вогняного металу]] [[de:Flammenkernerz]] [[fr:Minerai de flametal]]
